system.creatureSubtype: Darkvision 120 ft, Blindsight 30 ft, can inspire fear, Immune to Fear
system.tactics: Drakes open with Frightful Presence to scatter weaker foes, then unleash Fire Breath on clustered enemies. They use flight to stay mobile, strafing with breath weapon when recharged.  Drakes  retreat if reduced below 60 HP, remembering enemies for future vengeance.
system.attacksNotes:
Bite [Combat]: Melee attack (Agil 7 + Melee Combat 7), Reach: 10 ft

  • Margin 1:: 14 damage (8 + 6 Str) + 4 fire damage
  • Margin 2: 14 damage, DR halved (round up) + 4 fire damage

Claw [Combat]: Melee attack (Agil 7 + Melee Combat 7 vs opponent's defense), Reach: 5 ft

  • Margin 1:: 14 damage (8 + 6 Str)
  • Margin 2: 14 damage, DR halved (round up)

Fire Breath (Recharge 5-8) [Combat]: 30-foot cone. Each creature in area makes Reflex save, adding 1 to both Reflex save dice. 0 successes: 36 fire damage 1 success: 18 fire damage 2+ successes: 9 fire damage
system.specialAbilitiesNotes: Large Size: Occupies 10×10 ft space, reach varies by attack. Frightful Presence (3/day): Each creature of dragon's choice within 60 feet that can see it must make Will [Easy] save: Failure: Frightened for 1 minute (can repeat save at end of each turn). Success: Immune to this dragon's Frightful Presence for 24 hours. Immunity: Fire damage, Frightened condition. Resilient Defense: 2/day - When fails a saving throw, can choose to succeed instead. Action Points (3): Boss template. Spend at the end of any other creature's turn: Move (1, up to half speed), Attack (1, no Multiple Action Penalty), Detect (1), Special Ability (2). Regains all at the start of its own turn.
